vulnerabilities.name: Insecure Deserialization
vulnerabilities.evidence: User-controlled data passed to unserialize() function
vulnerabilities.description: Insecure deserialization often leads to remote code execution. Even if it doesn't result in RCE, it can be used to perform replay attacks or privilege escalation.
vulnerabilities.solution: Avoid deserializing untrusted data. Implement integrity checks. Use serialization formats that only permit primitive data types.
